meta.home_title: YogaMaty — a yoga mat you can trace

passport.not_found: We couldn't find a passport record for batch
passport.load_error: We couldn't load the passport. Please try again in a moment.
passport.template_body: No real batch data has been entered yet; the values below are placeholders. They are replaced when the batch record is published.
passport.your_mat_lead: This is the passport for your mat. It was made in batch
passport.how_collected_1: Every record on this page was entered by hand by a named person at Empowerment Collective, and each change leaves a dated entry in the website's change history. This passport is a deliberately rudimentary prototype.
passport.how_collected_2: That is exactly the limitation TransparaTrade exists to fix: if every company enters its own data manually, those not committed to ethics or sustainability can enter false data. The automated version would record each tier's data at the source, with proof of where, when and how it was entered.
passport.elec_title: What uses power, and what doesn't.
passport.elec_1: Most of this mat's journey uses no electricity at all, including both weaving stages. At least one stage does. Publishing both facts side by side is more credible than either one alone.
passport.elec_2: Both looms — the one weaving the mat face and the one weaving the hemp backing — are hundred-year-old machines that run on no electricity at all. We do not say the mat is made without electricity: it is not.
passport.elec_how: Total kWh metered for the batch, divided by the number of mats. This is an average, not a per-mat measurement.
passport.wage_note: If a figure cannot yet be published, we publish who verified it and how, instead of publishing nothing.
passport.env_rule: We publish only what was measured, label estimates as estimates, and name the method. A short list of real numbers is worth more than a fabricated life-cycle assessment.
passport.recycled_content: Recycled content (% of finished weight from reclaimed sari)
passport.recycled_how: Inputs are weighed; recycled content is the weight of reclaimed sari divided by the finished weight of the mat.
passport.water_per_mat: Water used in processing, per mat
passport.water_how: Measured once for a batch, then divided by the number of mats.
passport.dye_claim: No dyes or chemicals are added in making YogaMaty. The reclaimed saris carry their original factory dyes, so we do not call the mat “dye-free.”
passport.standard_lead: These are measured or documented once and reused until something changes.
passport.withheld: Some details about the workshop are withheld to protect the women who work there.
passport.bridge: This passport is hand-entered. TransparaTrade would make it automatic, and make it the law.
